metadata.description: Let Claude Code watch videos: Instagram reels, TikToks, YouTube, X and local files.

plugins.name: reel-watch
plugins.description: Let Claude watch a video. Paste an Instagram reel, TikTok, YouTube, X link or a local video: it downloads it for free, has Gemini watch it with sound (or samples frames and transcribes locally), and writes down the tools, links and commands it shows.
